name: quartz-builder
description: Implementation of Quartz static site generator (https://github.com/jackyzha0/quartz) + ExpressJS hosting . This can be used to make a static website from your Obsidian vault. I have not created Quartz, this is purely a service to host it in Unraid.

paths.name: Vault location
paths.description: The location of the vault of the user

paths.name: Output folder location
paths.description: The location where the html files will be exported (for example in /appdata/nginx/www/ if you use nginx to host the files)

variables.name: Vault folder name
variables.description: How we call the internal /vault folder (don't change)

variables.name: Output dir name
variables.description: How we call the internal /output folder (don't change)

variables.name: Timer
variables.description: Time that has to be inbetween changes to the documents in the watched folders before we run the build pipeline

variables.name: Folder to watch
variables.description: The folder in your obsidian vault you want to output (default is /public, leave empty for root)
